correctness.rationale: The sphere supremum equals the convex maximum over the square ball, hence is attained at product extreme points. The Rademacher reduction is exact, the identity max((A+B)^2,(A-B)^2)=A^2+B^2+2|AB| yields 1+(2/n)a_k a_(n-k), and log-concavity of c_q=a_(2q-1)=a_(2q) with ratio (2q+1)/(2q) gives the stated parity maxima. Stirling gives the limit. Exact enumeration through n=8 and closed-form checks through n=12 replay with VERIFY_OK; finite checks are not used to justify the infinite proof.
